clips.title: The story
paras: After the earlier Guile of the Raptor, Tor'gan hands you an orb and sends you to Gor'mul at Hammerfall. Its energy carries the essence of the raptor, meant to stir Gor'mul's spirit and give him new purpose.

Tor'gan gives you an orb whose energy is meant to fill Gor'mul with the raptor's essence. He hopes it will rouse the warrior's spirit and set him on a fresh course in life. Once Gor'mul is himself again, Tor'gan means to explain the current state of the Horde to him and gain a great warrior's help in the unceasing battles.
Gor'mul greets your return with sourness, saying he wants nothing more than more of Tor'gan's pity and mocking you with talk of brightly colored string.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this orb and use its energy to give Gor'mul the essence of the raptor. Surely this will invigorate his spirit and give him new purpose in life. With him returned to normal, we can explain to him the current state of the Horde, and we will have a great warrior's assistance in our unceasing battles.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Returned again have you? Indeed there is nothing more I could wish for now than more of Tor'gan's pity.
What have you for me this time? Perhaps a piece of brightly colored string? Or a length of rope to end this misery of mine...

clips.title: Completion
paras: At least it is something interesting you bring to me this time. A strange power it emits...
